origin.why_not_owned_by_A02: separable: the claim concerns any base LM scored by babilong.metrics on a generative task, with or without CoMem or a depth knob. A02 retains provenance and the source generations, not ownership.
origin.why_not_owned_by_B04: B04's construct is per-item acc_norm decision-margin compression under model damage -- a likelihood-ranking metric over MC options, no generation, no retrieval, no string matching, status NARROWED_TO_OLMO_2_ONLY. This is a generative string-matching scorer's TEXT PREPROCESSING interacting with output format. Same umbrella word 'eval fragility', different measured construct, different mechanism, different failure surface. Merging would let the OLMo-2-only margin claim borrow support from an unrelated mechanism.

claim: A generative long-context benchmark scorer's text preprocessing can encode output-format conventions strongly enough to destroy the RANKING of a true effect of +70 to +84 pp, and the failure localises to specific auditable lines of the metric.

established_measurements.inversion_significance: NOT significant: best exact McNemar p = 0.0703 on 8 discordant items (b=1,c=7); Holm-adjusted within the 6-cell family = 0.4219
established_measurements.claim_strength: RANKING FAILURE, not demonstrated sign error
established_measurements.one_operation_ablation: removing ONLY preprocess_output's first-period truncation (uniqueness requirement retained, so multiple-choice lists still score 0 and chance inflation is removed by construction) repairs the inversion on 2 of 6 cells and makes qa1x32k a perfect ladder rho=-1.000 p=0.0167; qa2 is unrepairable (floor, A4=1%)
established_measurements.cell_level_dissociation: the 4 inverting cells are EXACTLY the 4 high-list-format cells; [[4,0],[0,2]], Fisher exact p=0.0667 = the minimum attainable with 6 cells, so DESCRIPTIVE dissociation, not a powered test

refuted_hypotheses.retrieval_domination: REFUTED as the mechanism for the inversion. Conditioning on the arm-independent retrieval HIT/MISS label, the inversion is LARGER on HIT (qa1x16k HIT -6.67 vs MISS +8.57; qa2x32k -13.64 vs -5.41). Low recall@12 (22.9-63.2%) remains the correct reason these cells cannot support depth inference IN GENERAL, but it does not explain the inversion.
refuted_hypotheses.retracted_intermediate_number: a lenient format-insensitive read (target_in_raw) showed 4/6 sign flips, but it is chance-inflated for multiple-choice outputs and A4 emits lists far more often. The strict ablation gives 2/6. 2/6 is the number that stands.

not_identified: retrieval vs floor cannot be separated across 6 cells: Spearman(A0_acc, signed_sep) = +0.943 exact p=0.0167 (n=6 lower bound) but Spearman(recall, A0_acc) = +0.714, i.e. substantially collinear. Floor has the better sign, p and story, but the mechanism is NOT IDENTIFIED and must not be claimed.

ACL 2024 (2024.acl-long.744) moves leaderboard rank up to 8 positions by changing the answer-SELECTION method; Sanz-Guerrero et al. EMNLP 2025 (2025.emnlp-main.988) reshuffles rankings via tokenization of the 'Answer:' suffix; arXiv:2510.05152 states one can put any model in the lead by changing the single delimiter character. k1_novelty.why_not_fully_preempted: no located work varies ONE operation inside an existing GENERATIVE scorer while holding the generations BYTE-FIXED, and no located work breaks a ladder over ARMS OF ONE MODEL differing in output-format habit. All prior art varies the prompt (delimiter/tokenization/demonstrations/format constraints), swaps the extraction module wholesale (RegEx->model, extra inference pass), changes the metric FAMILY (EM->sMAPE, ROUGE->judge, EM->judge), or perturbs the benchmark (choice order, input-context truncation). Those are between-model leaderboard claims; B11's is a within-model between-arm claim.
k1_novelty.narrowed_claim: In a generative long-context benchmark whose scorer matches free-form output against a closed task-label vocabulary (babilong.metrics.compare_answers), a SINGLE text-preprocessing operation in the scorer's source -- truncation of the model output at the first period, metrics.py:27 -- interacts with an ARM-DEPENDENT output-format habit strongly enough that the scorer FAILS TO RECOVER THE ORDERING of a within-model architectural manipulation whose true effect is +58 to +84 pp on a retrieval-closed reference task. Demonstrated by re-scoring BYTE-FIXED generations with that one operation removed and nothing else changed: on 2 of 6 cells the inverted point estimate is removed, and on qa1x32k the 5-point ladder becomes rho = -1.000 (exact permutation p = 0.0167). The operation is NOT a one-directional bug -- it LOWERS scores for arms emitting choice-lists (list-format rate 62-75%) and RAISES them for arms emitting continuations -- and the four inverting cells are EXACTLY the four high-list-format cells ([[4,0],[0,2]], Fisher exact p = 0.0667, the minimum attainable at 6 cells, hence descriptive). The scorer contains a SECOND, independently verifiable defect: the guard intended to stop continuation leakage, metrics.py:31 split('Question'), is UNREACHABLE because metrics.py:25 lowercases first.

dead_code_recheck_20260814.mechanical_proof: 'Question' in s.lower() is False for EVERY s, because .lower() cannot produce a capital Q. Line 25 lowercases before line 31 splits on the capitalised literal. Contrast lines 29/30, which use the LOWERCASE tags '<context>'/'<example>' and therefore DO fire: preprocess_output('kitchen <CONTEXT> blah') -> 'kitchen '. So the defect is specific to line 31, and it is the one guard the authors wrote against continuation leakage.

abandoned.killed_by: K1 (novelty gate, 0 GPU) plus our own evidence, in three separate places. (1) LITERATURE: the general form 'scorer/extraction preprocessing changes model ranking' is already owned -- Alzahrani et al. ACL 2024 (aclanthology 2024.acl-long.744, venue field ACL) moves leaderboard rank by up to 8 positions via the answer-selection method; Sanz-Guerrero et al. EMNLP 2025 (aclanthology 2025.emnlp-main.988) reshuffles rankings via tokenization of the 'Answer:' suffix; arXiv:2510.05152 puts any model in the lead by changing one delimiter character. Asserting the claim unnarrowed walks straight into K1's own kill_if. (2) OUR OWN NUMBERS: '+70 pp' is not supported as a lower bound -- established_measurements gives [58.0, 54.0, 84.0, 84.0], minimum 54. (3) THE MECHANISM: executed re-verification shows first-period truncation is a SIGN-DEPENDENT TRADE-OFF, not a bug -- it kills correct list-format answers and rescues correct continuation-leak answers, and removing it LOWERS qa5 -- so 'the failure' cannot be described as a defect with a fix. Additionally the headline inversion is not significant (McNemar p=0.0703, Holm 0.4219).
abandoned.surviving_scope: TWO code-level facts about ONE scorer, both deterministic and CPU-checkable, plus a weak 6-cell descriptive pattern in ONE model family.
